# ClipForge AI

> ClipForge AI turns long videos into polished vertical clips for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and similar platforms.

ClipForge AI analyzes uploaded videos and video URLs, transcribes the source, proposes and scores promising segments, creates face-aware vertical crops, adds word-synced captions, and exports platform-ready clips. Use the hosted app at https://www.clipforge.ai or self-host this repository.

## Project links

- [ClipForge AI website](https://www.clipforge.ai/)

## Key capabilities

- AI-assisted clip discovery and candidate scoring.
- YouTube URL and uploaded-file inputs.
- Face-aware 9:16 vertical reframing.
- Word-synced animated captions and caption templates.
- Export presets for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels.
- Hosted web usage or self-hosting.
- Support for configured hosted language-model providers or Ollama.
- Transcription via AssemblyAI, local Whisper, or YouTube captions.
- REST API with per-user API keys, and an MCP server for AI clients.
- No watermark on exported clips.

## Notes

- Virality scores prioritize candidates; they do not guarantee audience performance.
- Self-hosters provide their own infrastructure and any paid transcription or model-provider usage.
- Users should process only videos they own or have permission to repurpose.
- Product capabilities and pricing can change; use the website and repository for current details.
